spans.text: Unit 5: Digital content
Cellular networks allow a large number of portable digital devices to communicate with each other over large distances.
Radio waves travel at the speed of light, which makes it easy for huge amounts of information to travel quickly across a Wi-Fi network.
Cellular networks use radio waves so mobile devices can communicate
Keywords
radio wave: a type of electromagnetic wave that travels at the speed of light
Wi-Fi: a type of wireless network
adapter: a device that is built in or attached to a digital device to enable the device to receive and send Wi-Fi signals
transmitter: device used to transmit Wi-Fi signals
receiver: device used to receive Wi-Fi signals
Did you know?
The space program sends radio waves to control computers on-board spaceships, satellites and probes.
Practise
1 Which of the following statements are true or false?
a Wi-Fi uses radio waves.
T
b Data can be sent using radio waves.
T
c Radio waves travel through cables to get to the router.
T
d Radio waves travel through the air.
T
e All digital devices have an adapter that can send and receive radio waves.
T
f All wireless digital devices can send and receive data via cellular networks.
T
2 Which device converts the data coming from the internet into a radio wave?
ROUTER
3 What is the name of the component that sends Wi-Fi signals?
ADAPTER
4 What is the name of the component that receives Wi-Fi signals?
ADAPTER
